events.description: You are cordially invited to the annual Veterans Day Celebration — an evening of honor, camaraderie and post-election celebration. Food, Beer, Wine and Music. Saturday, November 21, 2026, 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM, Morris Lawrence Building, Washtenaw Community College, 4800 E Huron River Dr, Ann Arbor, MI 48105. Mo’s dedication to serving veterans and strengthening veteran communities will make for an inspiring and meaningful presentation. You don't have to be a Veteran to attend — just care about Democratic and democratic ideals, and stand with Veterans of all stripes. events.title: OCDP Executive Committee Meeting + Officer Elections
events.description: OFFICIAL NOTICE: OCDP OFFICER ELECTIONS The Oakland County Democratic Party hereby provides official notice that elections for OCDP Officers will take place during the regularly scheduled Executive Committee meeting. Date: Tuesday, December 8, 2026 Time: 7:00 PM Location: OCDP Headquarters 17100 W. 12 Mile Road, Suite 5 Southfield, MI 48076 Pursuant to OCDP Bylaws and Standing Rules, individuals interested in seeking an officer position, whether individually or as part of a slate, must submit a written Declaration of Candidacy no later than Tuesday, December 1, 2026 . Declarations must be submitted to the OCDP Director of Operations at staff@ocdp.org . All candidates must satisfy the membership and eligibility requirements established under OCDP Standing Rules #5 and #6 and applicable Michigan Democratic Party rules. Candidates must submit an OCDP Membership Application before becoming eligible to stand for election or appointment. Officer elections will be conducted by the Oakland County Democratic Party Executive Committee in accordance with applicable party bylaws and election rules. Additional information regarding officer positions, eligibility, and election procedures is available through OCDP's governing documents at www.ocdp.org/bylaws. Newly elected officers will take office January 1, 2027.

events.title: A Season of Gratitude Holiday Party
events.description: As we close out an incredible 2026, it's time to come together to celebrate our victories, recognize the hard work of our members and volunteers, and enjoy some holiday cheer! A Season of Gratitude Saturday, December 19, 2026 1:00–4:00 PM Southfield, MI From the campaign trail to Election Day, our Democratic family has accomplished so much this year, and we couldn't have done it without YOU! Join us for an afternoon of fellowship, celebration, and appreciation as we reflect on all we've achieved together. This celebration is FREE and open to our OCDP community! Space will be limited, and advance registration will be required. Official invitation and RSVP details coming soon!

events.title: A Season of Gratitude | OCDP’s 2026 Holiday Party
events.description: Join the Oakland County Democratic Party for A Season of Gratitude, our 2026 holiday party, on Saturday, December 19, at 1:00 p.m. in Southfield. We’re getting together to thank the volunteers who knocked doors, the club leaders who brought neighbors together, and everyone who gave their time this year. We’ll also raise a glass to former Congresswoman Brenda L. Lawrence in appreciation of her leadership as OCDP Chair. The celebration is free and open to everyone. Whether you spent election season with us or you’re joining us for the first time, we’d love to see you. Bring a friend and RSVP below so we can plan for you!
